title: Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Portal Successfully Migrated from earlier platform (nmba.dosje.gov.in) to the SAMAVESH Portal (https://www.dosje.gov.in/organisation/nasha-mukt-bharat-abhiyaan/) developed by National e Governance Division
subtitle: New links and QR Codes include NMBA Portal https://www.dosje.gov.in/organisation/nasha-mukt-bharat-abhiyaan; NMBA; e-Pledge: https://nashamukt.dosje.gov.in/epledge; Nasha Mukti Mitr Registration:   https://nashamukt.dosje.gov.in/nasha-mukti-mitr; NMBA Login: https://nashamukt-admin.dosje.gov.in/login and NMBA Mobile App: https://play.google.com/store/search?q=nasha+mukt+bharat+abhiyan&c=apps&hl=en
body_text:
The Department of Social Justice & Empowerment (DoSJE) has completed the migration of the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan (NMBA) Portal from the earlier platform (nmba.dosje.gov.in) to the SAMAVESH Portal (https://www.dosje.gov.in/organisation/nasha-mukt-bharat-abhiyaan/) developed by National e Governance Division (NeGD).
Joint Secretary (Drug Prevention) in the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Dr Sandeep R. Rathod , informed that the NMBA Portal is now accessible through new links and QR Codes. These include 1. NMBA Portal https://www.dosje.gov.in/organisation/nasha-mukt-bharat-abhiyaan, ; 2. NMBA; e-Pledge: https://nashamukt.dosje.gov.in/epledge ; 3. Nasha Mukti Mitr Registration: https://nashamukt.dosje.gov.in/nasha-mukti-mitr ; 4. NMBA Login: https://nashamukt-admin.dosje.gov.in/login and 5. NMBA Mobile App: https://play.google.com/store/search?q=nasha+mukt+bharat+abhiyan&c=apps&hl=en
Dr Rathod said that the earlier NMBA Portal (https://nmba.dosje.gov.in/) has been discontinued following the successful migration and shall no longer be accessible.
Nasha Mukti Mitr Registration QR Code
NMBA Mobile App
The Ministry has asked all Line Ministries/ Departments to use new links for NMBA Portal, e-Pledge and Mitr Registration . All stakeholders have been asked to ensure that all future access to the NMBA portal is through the new SAMAVESH Portal Links and any references to the old portal link in official communications, websites, IEC material or other documents needed to be updated accordingly. The existing login credentials shall continue to remain valid unless communicated otherwise.
NNMBA e Pledge QR Code
All activities, reporting, e-Pledges, Nasha Mukti Mitr registrations, and other portal-based functions shall henceforth be carried out through the new portal.
In case of any clarification, Sh. Arun Kumar Karn, Under Secretary, Department of Social Justice and Empowerment , may be contacted through
usdp1-dosje[at]gov[dot]in

enrichment.summary: The Department of Social Justice & Empowerment has migrated the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan (NMBA) Portal from its earlier platform to the new SAMAVESH Portal developed by the National e-Governance Division. New links and QR codes have been issued for the NMBA Portal, e-Pledge, Nasha Mukti Mitr registration, admin login, and mobile app, and the old portal has been discontinued. Existing login credentials remain valid, and all stakeholders have been asked to update references to the new links.
enrichment.context:
Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan is a flagship initiative of the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment aimed at creating a drug-free India through awareness generation, community outreach (via 'Nasha Mukti Mitras' or volunteers), and institutional de-addiction efforts across identified vulnerable districts. It works alongside the National Action Plan for Drug Demand Reduction and complements enforcement efforts by agencies like the Narcotics Control Bureau under the Ministry of Home Affairs.

This release is purely a technical and administrative update about shifting the NMBA's digital infrastructure to a unified e-governance platform (SAMAVESH), likely part of a broader push to consolidate government portals under NeGD standards for better citizen access and data management. It does not reflect any change in policy, scheme design, funding, or outreach strategy.
